<!-- FROM DISPLACEMENT TO PURPOSE                    -->
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<section class="reveal-on-scroll" style="background-color: #FFFFFF; padding: 4.5rem 1.5rem;">
  <div style="max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: left;">
    <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #A8871F; margin: 0 0 0.7rem;">His Story</p>
    <h2 style="font-family: Playfair Display, serif; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.2vw, 2.35rem); color: #0B1F3B; margin: 0 0 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2;">
      From Displacement to Purpose
    </h2>
    <div style="width: 60px; height: 3px; background-color: #D4A017; margin-bottom: 1.6rem;"></div>

    <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.8; color: #5A5955; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;">
      Evangelist Gai Bol Luom's story is one of resilience, faith, and divine calling. Born and raised in South Sudan, Gai's early life was marked by the profound challenges facing his nation — conflict, displacement, and the struggle for stability that continues to shape the lives of millions across the diaspora.
    </p>

    <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.8; color: #5A5955; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;">
      Like many South Sudanese families, Gai and his loved ones experienced the upheaval of displacement. This journey — marked by uncertainty, loss, and the search for safety and opportunity — became the crucible in which his faith deepened and his calling crystallized. Through it all, Gai clung to Scripture and community, discovering that faith is not a luxury in times of plenty, but a lifeline in seasons of trial.
    </p>

    <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.8; color: #5A5955; margin-bottom: 0;">
      Gai pursued education with determination, recognizing it as both a personal pathway and a tool for serving others. His academic journey reinforced what he had learned through lived experience: that preparation and education unlock potential, and that young people — especially those carrying the weight of displacement and life transition — need intentional investment to thrive.
    </p>

    <!-- Photo: Gai on the ground in South Sudan -->
    <div style="margin-top: 2.5rem; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; position: relative;">

<!-- FAITH AS FOUNDATION                             -->
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<section class="reveal-on-scroll" style="background-color: #F7F6F2; padding: 4.5rem 1.5rem;">
  <div style="max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: left;">
    <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #A8871F; margin: 0 0 0.7rem;">His Faith</p>
    <h2 style="font-family: Playfair Display, serif; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.2vw, 2.35rem); color: #0B1F3B; margin: 0 0 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2;">
      Faith as Foundation
    </h2>
    <div style="width: 60px; height: 3px; background-color: #D4A017; margin-bottom: 1.6rem;"></div>

    <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.8; color: #5A5955; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;">
      Throughout his journey, Gai's deepening relationship with Christ became central to his identity and purpose. He came to understand that faith was the foundation for his identity and his responsibility to his community — the lens through which he could see both with clarity and love.
    </p>

    <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.8; color: #5A5955; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;">
      Gai's faith journey taught him that God sees the marginalized, honors the displaced, and raises up leaders from unexpected places. He witnessed firsthand how Scripture speaks powerfully to those facing adversity, and how a faith community rooted in God's Word becomes a place of healing, hope, and transformation.
    </p>

    <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.8; color: #5A5955; margin-bottom: 0;">
      This spiritual foundation became the bedrock upon which Y.E.T. Compassion was built. In 2006, Gai began the work of serving his people — and the ministry that followed drilled wells, delivered food aid and medical supplies, and supported schooling in the Biong community until war forced a halt in 2013. The conviction never changed: young people need not just education and skills — they need to know they are seen, valued, and called by God to something greater than their circumstances.
    </p>
